Natural Earth BC and Alberta province outlines
Authors: Tom Patterson, Nathaniel Vaughn Kelso, and contributors
Source revision: ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19
Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/ca96624a56bd078437bca8184e78163e5039ad19/geojson/ne_50m_admin_1_states_provinces.geojson
Terms: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/

Natural Earth publishes this map data in the public domain and permits its
use, modification and distribution without requesting permission.

Better Peakbagger includes only the BC and Alberta outer rings, rounded to five
decimal places. They select map services locally, with conservative padding.
They do not establish land ownership, access or camping permission.
